Bottle change.formula:
CASE WHEN MIN(Current_YTD_Ready) = 1 AND MIN(Prior_YTD_Ready) = 1 THEN (\nSUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(Month) = YEAR(Reporting_Month) AND MONTH(Month) <= MONTH(Reporting_Month)
  THEN IFNULL(Retail_Bottles_Sold, 0) + IFNULL(Wholesale_Bottles_Sold, 0) ELSE 0 END)
- SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(Month) = YEAR(Reporting_Month) - 1 AND MONTH(Month) <= MONTH(Reporting_Month)
  THEN IFNULL(Retail_Bottles_Sold, 0) + IFNULL(Wholesale_Bottles_Sold, 0) ELSE 0 END)\n) END

reportingMonthMetrics.Reporting-month retail bottles: SUM(CASE WHEN Month = Reporting_Month THEN Retail_Bottles_Sold ELSE 0 END)
reportingMonthMetrics.Reporting-month wholesale bottles: SUM(CASE WHEN Month = Reporting_Month THEN Wholesale_Bottles_Sold ELSE 0 END)
reportingMonthMetrics.Reporting-month total bottles: SUM(CASE WHEN Month = Reporting_Month THEN Retail_Bottles_Sold + Wholesale_Bottles_Sold ELSE 0 END)

Bottle data status.formula: CASE WHEN Available_Months = 0 THEN "History pending" WHEN Current_YTD_Ready = 0 OR Prior_YTD_Ready = 0 THEN CONCAT(FORMAT_DATETIME("%b %Y", Reporting_Month), " available · YTD history incomplete") ELSE CONCAT(FORMAT_DATETIME("%b %Y", Reporting_Month), " available") END
